acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using BiuBiu Tools, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

description.title: Description of Service
description.content: BiuBiu Tools provides Web3 utility tools for interacting with blockchain networks, including but not limited to wallet management, token operations, contract deployment, and batch transactions. These tools are provided "as is" and are intended for experienced users who understand blockchain technology.

risks.title: Blockchain Risks
risks.intro: You acknowledge and accept the following risks associated with blockchain technology:
risks.item1: Blockchain transactions are irreversible. Once confirmed, transactions cannot be undone or reversed.
risks.item2: Cryptocurrency values are highly volatile. You may experience significant losses.
risks.item3: Smart contracts may contain bugs or vulnerabilities that could result in loss of funds.
risks.item4: Network congestion may delay transactions or result in higher fees than expected.
risks.item5: Regulatory changes may affect the legality or usability of cryptocurrencies in your jurisdiction.

no_advice.title: No Financial Advice
no_advice.content: BiuBiu Tools does not provide financial, investment, legal, or tax advice. All information and tools provided are for informational and utility purposes only. You should consult with qualified professionals before making any financial decisions. Any actions you take based on information from our platform are at your own risk.

user_responsibility.title: User Responsibility
user_responsibility.item1: Safeguarding your private keys, seed phrases, and passwords. We do not store or have access to these.
user_responsibility.item2: Verifying all transaction details before signing or submitting transactions.
user_responsibility.item3: Understanding the implications of each action you take on the blockchain.
user_responsibility.item4: Complying with all applicable laws and regulations in your jurisdiction.
